invariants: All four independent situation sources are frozen before presenting any question.
Each source has the same actual household, home and inventory and its own scenario/session identity.
No source has prior user actions, concern assumptions, preset choices or hypothetical interventions.
Each phase captures one actual user command before feedback; unsupported anchors remain unassessed.
No uncaptured user or director commits may enter any source during an incomplete check.
Interruptions resume the same identity, order, sources and first answers; sessions cannot be reused for a new check.
A newer incomplete check governs current practice while completed older checks remain history.
There is no speed, equipment-cost, physical-ability, LiDAR or difficulty multiplier.
Equivalent text/manual input, translation, VoiceOver and reading time are accessibility support.
All scores remain provisional pending variant comparability and human review.
